nodes.name: Lecture workspace
nodes.description: Client route coordinates authenticated lecture sessions, transcript segments, notes, provider status, and API calls.

nodes.name: PCM capture worklet
nodes.description: AudioWorklet resamples microphone input to 16 kHz, emits PCM chunks, and reports RMS level.

nodes.name: Realtime lecture hook
nodes.description: Opens the lecture WebSocket, sends session controls and PCM chunks, handles server events, reconnects, and can use browser speech fallback.

nodes.name: Cloudflare Worker
nodes.description: Worker routes /api/lecture-realtime upgrades and otherwise delegates application requests to the Vinext app router.

nodes.name: Translation refinement
nodes.description: Authenticated /api/translate validates incremental requests, calls Qwen-MT, retries Chinese-quality failures, and records translation usage.

nodes.name: Structured notes
nodes.description: Authenticated /api/summarize converts completed segments into normalized, transcript-grounded bilingual revision notes through Qwen.

nodes.name: Lecture assist
nodes.description: Authenticated /api/lecture-assist explains, simplifies, exemplifies, or defines a selected excerpt through Qwen.

nodes.name: Authentication & quota
nodes.description: Session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax. Auth checks active users and records or limits API usage through the application database.

nodes.name: IndexedDB workspace
nodes.description: The browser persists the current workspace and optional lecture audio blobs in the lecture-workspace database.

nodes.name: Qwen services
nodes.description: Qwen-MT handles refinement; Qwen chat-completions handles summaries and lecture assistance. Keys are read only in server routes from the Cloudflare environment.
